name: FIRST EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System)
operator: FIRST - Forum of Incident Response and Security Teams (EPSS SIG); daily score files generated and hosted by Empirical Security for the EPSS SIG
tier_rationale: Established security non-profit with published terms (A8 trusted: established security non-profits); P184 cond 3 'Registry provider first: tier trusted, terms open'.

reliability.justification: A published, peer-reviewed prediction model (probability of exploitation activity in the next 30 days), rescored daily: a calibrated estimate, not an observation of exploitation; model versions shift every score.

epss_csv.title: EPSS daily bulk scores epss_scores-current.csv.gz (dataset; local lookups only, zero per-CVE calls)

terms.quote: Yes. EPSS scores are published freely via CSV download and API with no registration required. Attribution is requested when EPSS data is used in publications or products.

epss_csv.notes: Research C0430 terms 'FIRST EPSS (free, attribution)'. epss.empiricalsecurity.com/epss_scores-current.csv.gz answers a 302 with a RELATIVE Location to the dated file (epss_scores-YYYY-MM-DD.csv.gz); the legacy epss.cyentia.com URL answers 301 to it. 2.9 MB gzip -> 12.6 MB CSV (412,861 rows, first line '#model_version:...,score_date:...'): a large dataset, fetched by `v3lum data update epss_scores`, never during a scan (A6 BR9). A missing dated object answers an S3 403 AccessDenied: the previous copy is kept. FIRST attribution in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (P184 cond 3). Used by epss and epss_api (batch p1-G08-1).

epss_api.title: EPSS API api.first.org/data/v1/epss?cve= (one CVE per run, only for CVEs missing from the day's file)

terms.quote: Yes. EPSS scores are published freely via CSV download and API with no registration required. Attribution is requested when EPSS data is used in publications or products.

epss_api.notes: Research C0430 (verified_live 200; Fastly cache, Cache-Control max-age=86400). The API never reports bad input: unscored CVEs, malformed ids and malformed dates all answer 200 {status OK, total 0} (misses take 6-10 s at the origin), so ids are validated locally first and an empty answer means 'no score published', never 'not exploitable'. No published quota ('designed for lookup, not bulk'): one CVE per run, min_interval 1 s, CVE fan-out rule (P183 cond 3).

notes: Owned by batch p1-G08-1 (P184 epss + epss_api). Other batches extend it (first__<suffix>.json). The bulk file's current host epss.empiricalsecurity.com is declared together with the legacy redirect host epss.cyentia.com (P184 cond 3).
